snippet.title: The Jacksons Live in Rotterdam | Show You The Way To Go (May 24, 2026)
snippet.description:
🎶 The Jacksons keep the legacy alive at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands!

With original members Jackie Jackson and Marlon Jackson leading the way, backed by an incredible live band, the night was a true celebration of the hits that shaped generations — from Motown classics to timeless Jackson 5 and Michael Jackson gold.

Decades on stage, and that legacy still hits just as hard.

With original members Jackie Jackson and Marlon Jackson leading the way, backed by an incredible live band, the night was a true celebration of the hits that shaped generations — from Motown classics to timeless Jackson 5 and Michael Jackson gold.

Decades on stage, and that legacy still hits just as hard.

🎬 Footage captured by and courtesy of Janneke van der Linden (Jackson Source). 
🎬 Footage courtesy and property of Jackson Source and J5 Enterprises, LLC.
